title: WM-Quant: Rollout-Aware Post-Training Quantization for JEPA-Style World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.21882v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present WM-Quant, to our knowledge, the first post-training quantization (PTQ) framework designed specifically for JEPA-style world models. Although world models typically feature relatively few parameters, action planning algorithms often require thousands of inferences, which can quickly become computationally expensive. PTQ is a natural way to reduce this cost. However, we show that in world models using autoregressive model predictive control (MPC) rollouts, quantization error can compound with each predictor step, resulting in action rankings from the quantized model becoming near-random. WM-Quant addresses this with three components that build on existing PTQ methods: early-encoder precision, control-path preservation, and rollout-aware scaling. translated_title: WM-Quant：面向JEPA风格世界模型的感知推演的后训练量化
translated_abstract: 据我们所知，我们提出的WM-Quant是首个专门为JEPA风格世界模型设计的后训练量化（PTQ）框架。尽管世界模型的参数量通常相对较少，但动作规划算法往往需要数千次推理，这会迅速带来高昂的计算成本，而后训练量化正是降低这一成本的自然途径。然而，我们证明，在使用自回归模型预测控制（MPC）推演的世界模型中，量化误差会随每个预测器步骤不断累积，导致量化模型给出的动作排序几乎变为随机。WM-Quant通过在现有PTQ方法基础上构建的三个组件来解决这一问题：早期编码器精度、控制路径保持以及感知推演的缩放。早期编码器精度保护准确的潜在状态与目标信息，以减轻长期误差传播；控制路径保持使世界模型预测器能够区分……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: WM-Quant是首个针对JEPA风格世界模型的后训练量化框架，通过早期编码器精度、控制路径保持和感知推演缩放三项技术，解决了自回归MPC推演中量化误差逐步累积导致动作排序近乎随机的问题。
en_tdlr: WM-Quant is the first post-training quantization framework for JEPA-style world models, mitigating compounding quantization errors in autoregressive MPC rollouts through early-encoder precision, control-path preservation, and rollout-aware scaling.
